audited_candidate.text:
For now, I think of it in five stages. There's direct research behind some of the pieces, but the arrangement is mine.

1. Child alone — orient to the present and make sure there's enough safety around you to begin.
2. Borrowed adult — experience one reliable adult function through someone real, remembered, imagined, or symbolic.
3. Adult apprentice — do at least one part of the caring yourself while support is still there.
4. Inner adult — with repetition, warmth, protection, and direction get easier to call up on your own.
5. Adult and child in relationship — the adult leads. The child isn't pushed away and doesn't have to run the whole life alone.

“I am still this child, and I am also becoming the adult who stays.”
